ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 v_property varchar2(200);
 v_temp number:=0;
BEGIN
 IF :chk_term = 'Y' then
 If :ctrl_blk_1.s_search is not null then 
 --v_property := 'UPPER(event_desc) like ' || '''%' || :ctrl_blk_1.s_search || '%''';
 v_property := ' chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and UPPER(event_desc) like ' || '''%' || :ctrl_blk_1.s_search || '%''';
 set_block_property('community_events',default_where,v_property);
 select nvl(count(*),0) 
 into v_temp 
 from community_events 
 where UPPER(event_desc) like '%'||:ctrl_blk_1.s_search||'%'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 Else 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from community_events where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id; 
 End if;
 ELSE 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_search is not null then 
 v_property := '(term_date is null or term_date > sysdate) and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id' || 
 'and UPPER(event_desc) like '||'''%'||:ctrl_blk_1.s_search||'%''';
 set_block_property('community_events',default_where,v_property);
 select nvl(count(*), 0) 
 into v_temp 
 from community_events 
 where (term_date is null or term_date > sysdate) 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and UPPER(event_desc) like '%'||:ctrl_blk_1.s_search||'%';
 else 
 
 v_property := '(term_date is null or term_date > sysdate) and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id';
 set_block_property('community_events',default_where,v_property);
 select nvl(count(*),0) 
 into v_temp 
 from community_events 
 where (term_date is null or term_date > sysdate) 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 end if;
 END IF;
 if v_temp > 0 then 
 go_block('community_events');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 execute_query;
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.chk_term','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_search','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve','D');
 else 
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 set_block_property('community_events',default_where,'');
END;
